name: a measure whose bar is 3-5 between two hidden marks
why: Two arabic letter marks around "3-5" display it as "5-3": the snapshot says the bar is 3-5 and the page says the opposite, every check is green, and `git diff` shows the reviewer `"bar": "3-5"` and neither mark. The whole safety argument for a committed snapshot is that a human reads the diff, so a character that cannot be read in one is refused (decided on #27, 28 Oct 2026).
